easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Hades, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

uses.name: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
